explanation: Subtracting the equations gives (k−1)y=0. Since k≠1, y=0 and then x=0. Thus the homogeneous system has the unique zero solution.

answers.correct_value: The system $[\begin{aligned}1 & 1 \\ 1 & k\end{aligned}][\begin{aligned}x \\ y\end{aligned}]=[\begin{aligned}0 \\ 0\end{aligned}]$ has the unique zero solution
